title: ‘Filipiñana’ star Jorrybell Agoto dies at 31

blocks.text: Jorrybell Agoto, the lead actress of the Philippines’ official entry for Best International Feature Film at the 2027 Oscars, “Filipiñana,” has died at the age of 31. The Film Development Council of the Philippines (FDCP) confirmed her death in a Facebook post on Thursday, Nov. 19, accompanied by an art card honoring the actress. “Lubos na nakikiramay ang Film Development Council of the Philippines (FDCP) sa pamilya at mga mahal sa buhay ni Ms. Jorrybell Agoto — Lead Actress, Filipiñana (1994–2026),” read the post. “Ang iyong kontribusyon sa industriya ng Pelikulang Pilipino ay mananatiling nakatatak sa aming puso.
